folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B374: explicit G1 prerequisites
folds.body:
The complete [surface census](COVERAGE.md) and [G1 disposition table](RESUME.md) qualify the earlier audit reconciliation. The sixteen reached surfaces use different routes: matched native reading progress/XP, an actual purchase-triggered preparation lesson, paid membership and companion meeting, owner-factory inherited-life state, explicit awakening prerequisites and a localhost-only credit probe. A mismatched reading fixture was rejected and corrected without bypassing loader integrity. These routes establish the declared panel states, not natural acquisition time, a played lifetime, committed observer watch or ordinary activation of the credit prototype. Known-route rendering fixes first discovery behind a hidden parent without changing travel quotes or commands. Stock counts mean item kinds, not units or capacity.

All 73 rows were reviewed. Registry `unset` types are not evidence of anonymous visible controls; qualified inline shell/native views are not interchangeable with every opened panel. The final 72/73 qualification leaves exact missing Optional-world content, and original versus G1 proof identities and focused/full-suite timing remain separate. The earlier full suite does not cover later G1 source. Current AD42 keeps human taste review optional; this reconciliation neither renews old branch permissions nor verifies integration.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B374: October 30 coverage findings and proposed remedies
folds.body:
The full [UI coverage audit](gap-audit-2026-10-30/ui_cov.md) preserves F1–F12 and COV1–COV15 as dated findings/proposals. Its concrete useful targets are visible navigation that opens no visible destination, ambiguous panel names and unavailable routes, controls without meaningful labels/reasons, dense ungrouped experiments/workroom/settings, duplicate projections and forms that obscure the native decision. F1 alone was separately reproduced on an archived HEAD; the broader sweep used a dirty working-tree bundle. Fresh Village, fresh Tingen, populated fixtures and gallery views are different populations. No live fight, rite, study or home build was begun, and larger text/effects-off were outside that audit.

COV2/11's collapsed or temporarily repurposed Reports proposal conflicts with the current [functional-shell scope](../UI_RULES.md#functional-housing-and-work-as-lived-context) preserving full-height Reports. Keep its meaningful center-space/scroll concern, but reopen geometry through the current owner, saved-layout compatibility and actual populated desktop targets. COV4's primitive/figure ratios and COV3/5/7/8/9's fixed word, button or panel counts are illustrative diagnostics, not acceptance law. A sparse valid state may deserve a truthful next step rather than deletion; an unknown date or subject stays unknown without a justified observer estimate. Useful prose need not acquire a drawing, animation or quota. Current prose-first direction and the later editorial rounds above govern.

COV6/10/12's naming, reason, shared-controller and ownership ideas remain useful while preserving internal IDs, saved layouts, pins and collapse choices (UR17). COV13/14's alternative skins and missing gallery forms remain palette proposals, not compulsory adoption. COV15's study/rite/pursuit/history figures need actual producer state, knowledge and a selected consumer; stage data cannot become a measured distance just to fill a drawing. AD51 permits a first useful shared seam without a second-world prerequisite. Existing source/quote/settlement ownership remains authoritative, and no calendar, provenance migration, goal save field, study system or all-world panel conversion is authorized by this audit. No screenshots, figures, runtime source or current defect were newly verified here.
